import pytest
import os
import psutil


def test_memory_plateaus_across_chunks(synthetic_chunk_path):
    from insightbatch.pipeline.runner import run
    import insightbatch.pipeline.runner as runner_mod

    process = psutil.Process(os.getpid())
    readings = []

    original_run = runner_mod.run
    # instrument by running the pipeline incrementally is out of scope here;
    # instead we run the real pipeline against a 40-chunk synthetic file and
    # sample RSS via the benchmark script's chunk hook exposed for tests.
    from insightbatch.pipeline.chunk_loader import iter_chunks
    from insightbatch.pipeline.transform import Transform
    from insightbatch.pipeline.aggregator import Aggregator

    transform = Transform()
    aggregator = Aggregator()
    for i, chunk in enumerate(iter_chunks(synthetic_chunk_path)):
        cleaned = transform.apply(chunk)
        aggregator.accumulate(cleaned)
        if i in (9, 39):
            readings.append(process.memory_info().rss)

    growth_mb = (readings[1] - readings[0]) / 1e6
    assert growth_mb < 30, f'expected roughly flat memory after chunk 10, grew {growth_mb:.1f}MB by chunk 40'
